many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only

from collections import Counter
def blkset(g,n):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    if H>W: return [g[i*n:i*n+n] for i in range(H//n)]
    return [[row[j*n:j*n+n] for row in g] for j in range(W//n)]
names=['1','2','3','4','5','6','7']
data={}
for name in names:
    inp,out=G['Demo pair %s input'%name],G['Demo pair %s output'%name]
    n=min(len(inp),len(inp[0])); bl=blkset(inp,n); tgt=[i for i,b in enumerate(bl) if b==out][0]
    data[name]=(tgt,bl,inp,out)
# Verify rule: exactly one block is not main-diagonal-mirror-symmetric; output = it.
ok=True
for name,(tgt,bl,inp,out) in data.items():
    n=len(bl[0]); f=[(i,all(b[r][c]==b[c][r] for r in range(n) for c in range(n))) for i,b in enumerate(bl)]
    asym=[i for i,s in f if not s]
    ok &= bool(tgt in asym)==True
    print(name,'target',tgt,'asymmetric-blocks:',asym,'OK' if bool(tgt in asym) else 'FAIL')
print('ALL OK' if ok else 'NOT A RULE')
